protocol.selection: Validation only; passing guardrails first, then minimum mean relative-error/rate-gap objective. Baseline objective zero.
protocol.guardrails: Per horizon: errors <= baseline*1.02 + .01 NM (1 ft altitude); rates drop <= .5 pp. Regime n>=100: mean error <= baseline*1.05+.01 NM; within-5-NM drop <=1 pp.
protocol.test_policy: Freeze one configuration before opening test labels. Audit that config at seeds 42,43,44; never choose a seed from test.
protocol.deployment_policy: Experiment artifacts only; no automatic replacement of served models.
protocol.design_note: Trial values, objective weights and practical guardrails are our own experimental design, not thresholds prescribed by a paper.
